questions.question: Explain why the Nazi-Soviet Pact was important. (4 marks)
questions.correctAnswer: The Nazi-Soviet Pact was important because it allowed Hitler to invade Poland without fear of a two-front war. The pact guaranteed Soviet neutrality and included a secret protocol dividing Poland between Germany and the USSR. questions.question: Explain why Britain and France declared war on Germany on 3 September 1939. (8 marks)
questions.correctAnswer: Britain and France declared war on 3 September 1939 because Germany invaded Poland on 1 September despite the British guarantee of 31 March 1939. questions.question: "The Treaty of Versailles made the Second World War inevitable." How far do you agree? (16 marks)
questions.correctAnswer: The Treaty of Versailles did NOT make war inevitable, but it created the conditions that made war possible.
